Great views, disappointing service
Dec 2023 • Friends
Visited 30th Dec in a large group of 16. Loved the atmosphere when we arrived, good music selection and fab views of the city. There was a large selection of cocktails; prices were on the high side for HMC, especially for beer. It was service that let things down. I suspect they are not used to dealing with large groups. Drinks took a long time to come. Paying for our drinks brought new challenges! My husband was asked for his room number to charge his drink but we were not staying st the hotel, which seemed to confuse the staff no end. Overall a bit disappointing.

Magnificent Saigon view with nice evening breeze
Apr 2022
Truly relaxing and chilling Sky Bar with a magnificent panoramic view of Saigon City center! Ambience environment with nice music, a great place to lay back and have a sip at their unique list of cocktails. I would say the price is a bit high, but worth it with the view and service provided. 
Great service the moment you step into the bar, well greeted with a nice smile from this waitress, Luu Thi Mong Nhi, which I have to particularly name her because I was really amazed with her professionalism and great hospitality. She speaks fluent English and knows well her product. Came by once a while to check on us whether everything was ok, how was the drinks, etc......
Not like many other sky bars in Saigon, Above Sky Bar is somewhere you can enjoy and chat with friends without shouting your lungs out!
They serve food as well but we haven't the chance to try it out. But will definitely be back and taste some of their food.
Only downside is they close kind of early, last call at 11:30pm and closes at 12 midnight.
Highly recommend!
